scripts.check: npm run test && npm run build
scripts.package: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --dir --publish never
scripts.dist: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --publish never
scripts.test:staff: npm run build && node --test functions/staff-account.test.mjs && node scripts/staff-smoke.mjs
scripts.test:pos: npm run build && node --test functions/pos.test.mjs && node scripts/pos-smoke.mjs
scripts.build:checkout-domain: esbuild scripts/checkout-domain.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --minify --banner:js="// Generated by npm run build:checkout-domain; edit the shared TypeScript sources." --outfile=functions/checkout-domain.mjs
scripts.test:checkout: npm run build:checkout-domain && npm run build && node --test functions/pos.test.mjs && node scripts/pos-smoke.mjs --members && node scripts/pos-smoke.mjs --group
scripts.test:pos-catalog: npm run build && node --test functions/product-images.test.mjs && node scripts/product-image-smoke.mjs && node scripts/pos-smoke.mjs --catalog
scripts.test:theme: npm run build && node --test functions/theme.test.mjs && node scripts/pos-smoke.mjs --theme
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac --universal --publish never
scripts.test:updates: npm run build && vitest run tests/updates.test.ts && node --test scripts/release.test.mjs && node scripts/updates-smoke.mjs
